Title: Senior Help Desk Analyst
Company: Meridian Services Inc
Location: Remote - United States
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $78,000 annually

Meridian Services Inc provides IT support services to enterprise clients.

Responsibilities
- Lead escalations across the service desk team.
- Manage complex troubleshooting and mentor junior technicians.
- Maintain documentation and service metrics.

Requirements
- 5+ years of help desk experience
- ServiceNow
- Active Directory
